requirements.title: IEEE_SET_STATUS restores floating-point status
requirements.definition: IEEE_SET_STATUS restores the floating-point status to the state captured by the prior IEEE_GET_STATUS invocation.

pending.IEEE_SET_STATUS-restores-exception-flags: For each flag among IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,1.0). Named preamble HALTING_OFF(flag): IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag) true branch calls IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(flag,.FALSE.); IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag) false branch calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(flag,h) and proceeds only with h .FALSE.; h .TRUE. branch skips. Supported branch after HALTING_OFF(flag): clear all five flags with supported IEEE_SET_FLAG calls; set the selected flag true; save status; set the selected flag false; call IEEE_GET_FLAG for the selected flag into a .TRUE. sentinel and assert .FALSE. as the changed value; call IEEE_SET_STATUS(saved); call IEEE_GET_FLAG for the selected flag into a .FALSE. sentinel and assert .TRUE. restored. Unsupported flag or h .TRUE. branch: skip.
pending.IEEE_SET_STATUS-restores-rounding-mode: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,1.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_TO_ZERO,1.0). Supported branch: set IEEE_NEAREST, save status, set IEEE_TO_ZERO, call IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE and assert IEEE_TO_ZERO as the changed value, call IEEE_SET_STATUS(saved), then IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE and assert IEEE_NEAREST restored; unsupported branch: skip.
pending.IEEE_SET_STATUS-restores-underflow-mode: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(1.0). Supported branch: set gradual underflow true, save status, set abrupt underflow false, call IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE into a .TRUE. sentinel and assert .FALSE. as the changed value, call IEEE_SET_STATUS(saved), then IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE into a .FALSE. sentinel and assert .TRUE. restored; unsupported branch: skip.
pending.IEEE_SET_STATUS-restores-halting-mode: For each flag among IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag). Supported branch: set halting .FALSE., save status, set halting .TRUE. without raising an exception, call IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE into a .FALSE. sentinel and assert .TRUE. as the changed value, call IEEE_SET_STATUS(saved), then IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE into a .TRUE. sentinel and assert .FALSE. restored; unsupported branch: skip.
